policy.gate_scope: A gate on a CONTRACT blocks work that CONSUMES the contract (any coder task, anything under the go_target), not work that produces knowledge the decision needs anyway. While tier0 is blocked_on_gate, every other context is READY-FOR-ANALYSIS: analyst behaviour extraction from pinned source, test-corpus mining into capture plans, RAW observed vector capture on an oracle-reaching fire, and the Tier-C gap audit may all proceed. Contract-shaped storage, Go code, and amending the gated DEC-n may not. An open gate must never mean an idle factory.
